Lina Torres: Heads up - MistralCore wants to run a POC with a custom 'mistral-14b-lite' variant. They care about p95 < 180ms, support for session KV-cache, and want H100 affinity. Can we fit this in EU-CENTRAL-1?
Evan Wu: Do we have their model artifact? Also any tokenizer diffs? H100 affinity is fine but Dedicated capacity lead time increases.
Lina Torres: Artifact: https://mistralcore.share/models/mistral-14b-lite-v1.tar.gz. They said tokenizer uses sentencepiece v0.1.95 with extra special tokens. Quant plan: q5_1.
Nadia Singh: sentencepiece version bump + extra special tokens -> possible token id shifts. We'll need tokenizer alignment or a shim. Also q5_1 is new but we support q5 variants on H100 with our quant pipeline.
Oliver Park: Kernel note: q5_1 + H100 is good, but if they insist on A100 we might see +30% latency. Also check rotary vs alibi positional encodings.
Ravi Desai: Security: They want Private (VPC) deployment in eu-central-1 and customer-managed keys. We'll need infra ticket and an NDA addendum. Who owns the ingress?
Lina Torres: They will push data to our SFTP endpoint and expect logs off. NDA in review. For PII gating they prefer Private.
Evan Wu: Action plan: 1) run compat-scan on artifact (tokenizer, pos enc, attention type) 2) perf run on H100 dev node 3) infra ticket for Private+KMS in EU-CENTRAL-1 4) pricing draft. ETA 72 hours.
Nadia Singh: I'll run `./tools/compat --artifact /tmp/mistral14` now.
ci-bot: compat-check #88 queued by @nadia -> https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/88 :gear:
Nadia Singh: compat-check summary: tokenizer mismatch: 18 special tokens unmapped; pos encoding: rotary_detected=true; attention: standard causal. Quant plan q5_1 supported. Full: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/88/log.txt
Oliver Park: Rotary OK. Special tokens -> we should prefer shipping a tokenizer map file rather than changing model. KV-cache works with rotary.
Evan Wu: Perf run: `python perf/run.py --model /artifacts/mistral14 --device h100 --batch 1 --seq 512`
ci-bot: perf-job #89 started by @evan -> https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/89 :rocket:
Evan Wu: Perf results: p95 token latency batch=1, seq=512 => 170ms on H100 with q5_1, 230ms on A100. Memory ok. Canary throughput at 5rps sustained looks stable. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/89/metrics.json
Lina Torres: Great — H100 meets their p95 target. Can we promise H100 in Private? That will be a hardware-affinity SLA.
Ravi Desai: Hardware affinity in Private is doable but raises reserved capacity cost. Pricing note: adapter/onboarding fee $10k (tokenizer shim + infra setup). Trial per-token uplift +25% with H100 included, +40% if we must run on A100.
Nadia Singh: For the tokenizer shim I'll prepare a small Python package that maps new special tokens to our canonical ids and includes normalization. Should be quick.
Oliver Park: Also add a note that if customer updates tokenizer mid-POC, we need to re-run compat and QA which may add 2-3 days.
Lina Torres: Security checklist request: signed DPA, SOC2 snapshot, network diagram, KMS key material flow. Ravi please open infra ticket.
Ravi Desai: Ticket INF-2891 opened: https://infra.redwood.dev/tickets/INF-2891 2b tagged infra, security, and infra-sre. ETA for Private provision: 5 business days. KMS binding +2 days after infra prep.
Evan Wu: Demo script bullets for AE: 1) 'Validated H100 perf: 170ms p95 on q5_1.' 2) 'Tokenizer shim will preserve session continuity and KV-cache semantics.' 3) 'We offer hardware affinity on Private with a small reserved capacity uplift.'
Lina Torres: Sales materials: @ravi can you attach the two price tiers to this thread (H100 tier vs A100 fallback)?
Ravi Desai: Pricing doc: https://sales.redwood.dev/proposals/mistralcore-poc-draft 2b adapter $10k + per-token bands + SLA charges.
Nadia Singh: Small tech caveat: if they use custom special tokens for system prompts we should validate prompt routing to avoid weird truncation. I'll add a test case.
Oliver Park: I'll prepare a canary rollout plan: start 5% traffic on custom variant, monitor latency and error spikes for 24h, then expand. Add automatic fallback to our vetted 13b baseline if errors > 1% for 10 min.
Evan Wu: Can we ship the tokenizer shim in a way that customer can run locally for on-prem? Yes, we'll provide a wheel and a Docker image.
Lina Torres: Excellent. I'll update SOW and schedule intro call with the customer for next Wed. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: build/packager #90 completed -> wheel uploaded to https://artifacts.redwood.dev/wheels/mistral-shim-0.1.0.whl :package:
Ravi Desai: Linking INF-2891 and pricing doc in contract repo.
Lina Torres: Closing thread for now; will reopen if they ask for on-prem air-gapped deployment.
